logistics.format: Open-book proctored, includes CyberLive hands-on tasks

recommended_certs.rationale: OSCP と GPEN は同領域の権威ルート。両資格併取は攻撃側コンサル / レッドチーマーが顧客に対する信頼性を多重化する手法。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: CyberLive tasks, accreditation and a three-year assessment profile support professional testing delivery; recorded weaker peer recognition than OSCP and cost do not warrant either expert promotion or dismissal.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded DoD approval, accreditation and CyberLive tasks provide a strong professional pentest filter with a three-year profile. The shorter task-based assessment and weaker recorded peer signal than OSCP do not establish expert engagement leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: Recorded CyberLive tasks and a three-year profile provide applied penetration-testing evidence. This supports professional delivery, while the shorter assessment and recorded weaker peer signal than OSCP limit claims beyond that level.
